item.title: Animoca Brands secures VASP license from Dubai’s VARA
item.description: Animoca Brands, a global digital assets firm, announced Monday it has received a virtual asset service provider (VASP) License from Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA).

item.title: SMFG, IFC partner to launch $500M digital inclusion bond, supporting MSMEs in emerging markets
item.description: To promote digitalization and jobs in emerging markets, the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group, has partnered with Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMFG), a Japanese financial group, to launch the world’s first social bond exclusively dedicated to digital inclusion, including for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs), totaling $500 million.

item.title: Malaysia launches Government Innovation Initiative to accelerate AI Nation journey by 2030
item.description: In a move to fundamentally transform digital governance, the Ministry of Digital is activating the Government Innovation Initiative (GII), a strategic national undertaking poised to galvanize innovation across the public sector and advancing Malaysia’s commitment to achieving AI Nation status by 2030.

item.title: How do agentic reasoning AI doctors improve billing accuracy?
item.description: Agentic reasoning AI doctors represent the next evolution of healthcare automation. By combining medical understanding, autonomous decision-making, and intelligent task execution, these AI agents drastically reduce billing errors, prevent revenue loss, and strengthen financial health for hospitals and clinics.

item.title: Sea and Google deepen partnership to deliver AI-powered innovations for consumers globally
item.description: Sea Limited, a Singapore-based technology company founded in Singapore, announced Thursday an expanded strategic partnership with Google to advance the development of artificial intelligence (AI)-powered innovations that can serve users across Sea’s core business lines of digital entertainment, e-commerce, and digital financial services.

item.title: Philippines-owned fintech firm BCRemit expands global footprint to 23 countries
item.description: Building on its success in the retail remittance sector, BCRemit, a Filipino-led global digital remittance company, has expanded its services to 23 countries and announced plans to scale its operations to provide tailored cross-border payment solutions beyond the overseas Filipino workers (OFWs).

item.title: LC Wakaful Digital launches Malaysia’s first registered social exchange platform
item.description: LC Wakaful Digital Sdn Bhd (LCWD), a wholly owned subsidiary of Gobarakah Tech Sdn Bhd, announced Thursday the official launch of Impakrintas, Malaysia’s first Social Exchange platform, following the Securities Commission Malaysia’s (SC) announcement on LCWD’s appointment as the inaugural Social Exchange Platform operator on February 12.

item.title: How AI is transforming cloud infrastructure for enterprises
item.description: Businesses are seeking to automate activities on cloud management, workload optimization, enhance cybersecurity, and enhance sustainability through AI-driven tools. It is not just a shift toward lowering expenses but also facilitating the operation smarter, faster, and more strategically in what has become a highly competitive global economy.

item.title: How CEOs can leverage AI agents for Strategic decision-making
item.description: AI Agents empower CEOs to lead with confidence, speed, and clarity in an unpredictable world. As business becomes more data-driven and interconnected, those who leverage AI Agents for strategic decision-making will not just keep up, they will set the pace.

item.title: Malaysia’s VentureTECH invests $7.16M to strengthen national digital resilience in cybersecurity
item.description: VentureTECH Sdn Bhd, an impact investment company, has announced a strategic investment of MYR 28 million ($7.16 million) into Delta Spike Asia Sdn Bhd and IX Telecom Sdn Bhd, reinforcing Malaysia’s cybersecurity strength and cross-border digital infrastructure capability.
